name: 0.1-88-b2f2fcb
notes: New app icon: photographic daylight Falcon liftoff

name: 0.1-86-2103d02
notes: Smoke and clouds over the rocket are no longer capped at 50%

name: 0.1-84-c154fa0
notes: Sound: a synthesized engine rumble that follows the flame and goes muffled in thin air, rushing air through max-Q and re-entry, a deep boom for a breakup and a thump on touchdown. These carry the flight after the soundtrack ends.

name: 0.1-82-913b4e0
notes: Cartoon HUD: altitude and speed in white outlined pills, a fat fuel gauge that turns yellow then red as it runs low, and chunkier ENGINE and LEAN bars.

name: 0.1-80-6b51068
notes: Score: a landed flight is scored out of 10,000 (fuel, calm hands, following the guide, a clean release, pad centre, soft and upright touchdown), with a breakdown and your best score kept on the phone. Flights AUTO touched don't count as a best.
